chain.title: Notes from Other Explorers
chain.desc: Gather manuscripts from your explorations. They are research material for unlocking pages in the Bestiary.

chain.title: Keep a Record of the Beasts
chain.desc: Make a Bestiary and study the creatures you intend to approach. Many encounters have unique counters, and some creatures can be tamed rather than killed.

chain.title: A Place to Study
chain.desc: Place the Bestiary on a Lectern and use manuscripts to unlock more pages. Research the Dragonforge before committing to its large material cost.

chain.title: Equipment for the First Hunt
chain.desc: Gather silver and inspect the equipment recipes. Prepare armor, food and an escape route before visiting dangerous structures.

chain.title: The One-Eyed Cave
chain.desc: Challenge a Cyclops when equipped for a heavy melee fight. Its cave is an independent expedition, not a gate to all dragon content.

chain.title: A Trophy from the Cave
chain.desc: Recover the Cyclops Eye and inspect its use. Keep this reward separate from the fire-dragon crafting route.

chain.title: Never Meet Her Gaze
chain.desc: Research the Gorgon and prepare a blindfold before entering her temple. Her petrifying gaze makes an unprepared frontal approach dangerous.

chain.title: The Gorgon's Last Stare
chain.desc: Recover the Gorgon Head after the fight. Study its limited-use effect before spending this trophy.

chain.title: Hunt on Open Water
chain.desc: Prepare reliable underwater movement and breathing before challenging a Sea Serpent. Leave room to retreat from its attacks.

chain.title: Materials of the Tide
chain.desc: Gather Sea Serpent Fangs and scales for aquatic equipment. This route supports ocean exploration without requiring a dragon kill.

chain.title: A Many-Headed Challenge
chain.desc: Read the Hydra's Bestiary entry and prepare fire for the encounter. Manage the heads and regeneration rather than relying on raw damage alone.

chain.title: The Heart of the Marsh
chain.desc: Recover the Hydra Heart and study its effect. This is an optional legendary-hunt reward, separate from your Dragonforge project.

chain.title: Remains of a Dragon
chain.desc: Recover dragon bones from skeletons or defeated dragons. Bones can start the equipment branch before you defeat a living dragon yourself.

chain.title: An Edge for the Hunt
chain.desc: Craft a Dragonbone Sword and prepare fire protection. Study dragon behavior before approaching a roost or underground den.

chain.title: Your First Fire Dragon
chain.desc: Defeat a Fire Dragon with a plan for its breath and flight. Afterward, choose carefully how to harvest its corpse.

chain.title: Bottle the Dragon's Power
chain.desc: Use bottles on the dragon's corpse to collect blood before taking all its remains. Blood collection competes with the other harvests available from that corpse.

chain.title: Build the Dragonforge
chain.desc: Craft the Fire Dragonforge Core and follow the Bestiary's complete multiblock diagram. A core alone does not make an operational forge.

chain.title: Breathe Life into the Forge
chain.desc: Operate a complete Fire Dragonforge with a suitable fire dragon and the displayed ingredients. Collect the finished ingot before starting your first dragonsteel weapon.

chain.title: The Dragon's Strength in Your Hand
chain.desc: Craft a Fire Dragonsteel Sword. Your research, dragon handling and multiblock construction now converge in a working endgame weapon.

content_revision: 2026-10-07: explicit branches, operational guidance, no collection filler

coverage.scope: Bestiary research, independent legendary hunts, and fire-dragon equipment through a working Dragonforge.
coverage.limitations: Recipe quantities, enabled content and progression settings may be changed by the installed pack.
coverage.verification_detail: Item models, entity language identifiers, dimension data, recipes and bundled guide text where present were inspected; this is data verification, not a Minecraft playthrough.

notes: Each requires list is intentional. Empty lists are independent entry routes. Links describe guided progression or demonstrated recipe/boss gates, not an assertion that every dependency is a game-enforced lock. Runtime scanning still filters unavailable items and entities.
